note.sr: Sva otvorena pitanja ka timovima na jednom mestu, stanje posle prijema do 11.11. Svaka stavka kaže šta je pouzdano, šta nije i ko to može da potvrdi. Nerazrešeno se ne pogađa i ne briše — stoji ovde dok ne stigne odgovor; razrešeno nestaje sa spiska.
note.en: All open questions to the teams in one place, as of the intakes up to 11 Nov. Each item states what is reliable, what is not, and who can confirm it. Unresolved items are neither guessed nor deleted — they stand here until an answer arrives; resolved ones leave the list.

items.sr: Ušće Tower (T72): 08.11. stigla je i kurirana tabela o načinu gradnje Ušća 2 (25 zapisa), ali i dalje stoje indeksi 129/26, 18/26 i 69/26, pri čemu 18/26 i 69/26 već postoje u T54 i T51. T21 (135/26, 107/26, 114/26) radi Kulu Beograd, ali indekse u predajama nije naveo.
items.en: Ušće Tower (T72): on 8 Nov the table on Ušće 2 construction (25 records) arrived and was curated, but the indices 129/26, 18/26 and 69/26 still overlap with 18/26 and 69/26 in T54 and T51. T21 (135/26, 107/26, 114/26) works on Kula Beograd but has not stated its indices in any submission.
items.askSr: T72: potvrdite tačne oznake smera za indekse 18/26 i 69/26. T21: potvrdite indekse u sledećoj predaji.
items.askEn: T72: confirm the exact programme suffixes for indices 18/26 and 69/26. T21: confirm your indices in the next submission.

items.sr: Hotel Jugoslavija (T46): podnesci od 23.10. i 27.10. vezani su samo objektom, a pošiljalac dopune nije u registru T46 (89/26, 143/26, 153/26). Dve kule Beograd: istraživanje od 27.10. pripada T21 (ispravka 03.11).
items.en: Hotel Jugoslavija (T46): the submissions of 23 and 27 Oct are tied only to the object, and the sender of the supplement is not in the T46 register (89/26, 143/26, 153/26). Dve kule Beograd: the research of 27 Oct belongs to T21 (corrected 3 Nov).
items.askSr: T46: koji indeksi čine tim i da li pošiljalac dopune pripada timu?
items.askEn: T46: which indices form the team, and does the sender of the supplement belong to it?

items.sr: Hotel Moskva: T54 je u pasošu autorstva od 09.11. potvrdio indekse (18/26, 35/26, 56/26), ali indeksi tima T29 (enterijer) još nisu potvrđeni u predajama, a PDF knjige „Prvih 100 godina hotel Moskva“ koju je hotel poslao T54 još nije prosleđen u arhivu predmeta.
items.en: Hotel Moskva: T54 confirmed its indices (18/26, 35/26, 56/26) in the authorship passport of 9 Nov, whereas the indices of T29 (interior) remain unconfirmed in submissions, and the PDF of “The first 100 years of Hotel Moskva” sent by the hotel to T54 has not yet been forwarded.
items.askSr: T29: potvrdite indekse u sledećoj predaji. T54: prosledite PDF knjige koju je hotel poslao.
items.askEn: T29: confirm your indices in the next submission. T54: forward the PDF of the book sent by the hotel.

items.sr: Podnesak „Ложионица“ potpisale su tri studentkinje; 17/26 se vodi i u T10 (Pančevo) i u T04, a dve nove članice nemaju indeks u predaji — verovatno 15/26 i 90/26.
items.en: The „Ložionica“ submission is signed by three students; 17/26 is listed both in T10 (Pančevo) and in T04, and the two new members carry no index in the submission — probably 15/26 and 90/26.
items.askSr: 17/26: u kom timu radiš? T04: potvrdite indekse dve nove članice.
items.askEn: 17/26: which team are you in? T04: confirm the indices of the two new members.

items.sr: T71 (Miloša Pocerca 32): 30.10. potvrđen drugi član (13/26g) i katastarska parcela (KP 1283/1 KO Savski venac), ali 28 zapisa u pasošu još uvek navodi izvore samo opisno i čeka se izvod iz G-lista o statusu spomenika kulture.
items.en: T71 (Miloša Pocerca 32): on 30 Oct the second member (13/26g) and parcel (KP 1283/1 KO Savski venac) were confirmed, but 28 claims in the passport still cite sources only descriptively and the G-sheet extract on cultural monument status is awaited.
items.askSr: T71: pošaljite konkretne linkove/signature za 28 opisnih izvora i izvod iz G-lista.
items.askEn: T71: send concrete links/shelfmarks for the 28 descriptive sources and the G-sheet extract.

items.sr: Šest arhivskih crteža Kongresnog centra (Sava centar, Blok 19) — osnove, presek, situacioni plan i potpisana izjava projekanata — stiglo je bez ikakve poruke i bez podnosioca.
items.en: Six archive drawings of the Congress Centre (Sava Centar, Block 19) — plans, section, site plan and a signed statement of the project engineers — arrived with no message and no sender.
items.askSr: Čiji je ovaj prilog — T03, T60 ili neko treći?
items.askEn: Whose submission is this — T03, T60, or a third team?

items.sr: „Beogradski arhitriptih“ (AI aplikacija, prijemi 23. i 25.10.) stigao je kao zajednički rad T01, T02 i T03 i vodi se bez tima, jer nije jasno ko je autor kog dela.
items.en: The “Belgrade architriptych” (AI application, intakes of 23 and 25 Oct) arrived as joint work of T01, T02 and T03 and is filed without a team, as it is unclear who authored which part.
items.askSr: T01, T02, T03: ko je radio koji deo i da li se rad računa svakom timu posebno?
items.askEn: T01, T02, T03: who did which part, and does the work count for each team separately?

items.sr: Pasoš Hale 1 (T47, 31 zapis) navodi 18 izvora samo po naslovu, bez linka ili signature; poređenje sa CNIT-om stoji kao nepotvrđeno.
items.en: The Hall 1 passport (T47, 31 records) lists 18 sources by title only, without link or shelfmark; the comparison with CNIT stands as unconfirmed.
items.askSr: T47: pošaljite link, signaturu ili stranu za svaki od 18 izvora.
items.askEn: T47: send a link, shelfmark or page for each of the 18 sources.

items.sr: Dom omladine (T05): tabelarni deo pasoša ima izvore, opisni deo (10 zapisa) nema nijedan, pa su ti zapisi objavljeni kao nepotvrđeni.
items.en: Dom omladine (T05): the tabular part of the passport cites sources, the descriptive part (10 records) cites none, so those records are published as unconfirmed.
items.askSr: T05: dopišite izvor uz svaku tvrdnju opisnog dela.
items.askEn: T05: add a source to each claim in the descriptive part.

items.sr: Kula Beograd (T21): pasoš od 27.10. sam ostavlja sedam pitanja bez odgovora (objavljena su kao „nepoznato“), a tvrdnja o investitoru iz UAE nema izvor.
items.en: Kula Beograd (T21): the passport of 27 Oct itself leaves seven questions unanswered (published as “unknown”), and the claim about the UAE investor has no source.
items.askSr: T21: odgovori na sedam otvorenih pitanja iz vašeg dosijea i izvor za investitora.
items.askEn: T21: answers to the seven open questions in your dossier and a source for the investor.

items.sr: Narodna banka (T16), Beograđanka (T50 i T64), Geneks kula (T52), Narodno pozorište (T56) i West 65 Tower (T63) objavljeni su u javnom sloju i prihvaćeni za kolokvijum, ali su izvori navedeni zbirno na kraju bez vezivanja uz pojedinačne podatke; dosijei nose „Napomenu profesora“ dok ne stigne tabelarna verzija podatak → izvor (kao što su T31 30.10, T55 08.11. i T13 10.11. dostavili pojedinačne izvore).
items.en: National Bank (T16), Beograđanka (T50 and T64), Genex Tower (T52), National Theatre (T56) and West 65 Tower (T63) are published and accepted for the colloquium, but list sources only collectively at the end rather than per record; their dossiers carry a “Professor’s note” until a tabular claim → source version arrives (as T31 did on 30 Oct, T55 on 8 Nov and T13 on 10 Nov).
items.askSr: T16, T50, T52, T56, T63, T64: pošaljite verziju pasoša sa izvorom pored svakog podatka (za T56 i signaturu fonda arhivskih nacrta iz 1940).
items.askEn: T16, T50, T52, T56, T63, T64: send a passport version with a source next to each claim (for T56 also the archive shelfmark of the 1940 drawings).

items.sr: Zgrada RTS (T15): odeljak „Šta znamo o unutrašnjosti“ ima četiri zapisa koje tim sam označava kao nepoznate.
items.en: RTS building (T15): the section “What we know about the interior” has four records the team itself marks as unknown.
items.askSr: T15: da li četiri nepoznata podatka ostaju otvorena ili imate izvor?
items.askEn: T15: do the four unknown items stay open, or do you have a source?

items.sr: Iz brzih beleški sa konsultacija isti brojevi se javljaju u više timova: 8, 10, 18, 25, 26, 27, 32, 33, 47, 56 i 69 (dok je za T52 potvrđen broj 102/26 umesto 106/26). Parovi poput 49/26g i 49/26, 36/26g i 36/26, 29/26g i 29/26 označavaju različite studijske programe (OA / OG).
items.en: From quick consultation notes the same index numbers appear across multiple teams: 8, 10, 18, 25, 26, 27, 32, 33, 47, 56 and 69 (while 102/26 was confirmed for T52 instead of 106/26). Pairs such as 49/26g and 49/26, 36/26g and 36/26, 29/26g and 29/26 denote different degree programmes (Architecture / Civil Engineering).
items.askSr: Ako je tvoj broj gore, navedi pun oblik indeksa sa oznakom smera (OA / OG) u narednoj predaji.
items.askEn: If your number is listed above, state the full index including the programme suffix (OA / OG) in your next submission.

items.sr: Zapisi uz 15/25g i 36/26g kažu samo „spisak izvođača”, bez objekta.
items.en: The notes for 15/25g and 36/26g say only “list of contractors”, with no object named.
items.askSr: 15/25g i 36/26g: koji objekat istražujete?
items.askEn: 15/25g and 36/26g: which building are you researching?

items.sr: BIGZ — autorstvo konkursa 1933 (T76): digitalni pasoš sa 10 tvrdnji i izvorima i ručno crtana skica makete u formi štampača stigli su 10.11. bez navedenih brojeva indeksa, pa tim privremeno nosi oznaku 00/2026.
items.en: BIGZ — 1933 competition authorship (T76): the digital passport with 10 sourced claims and the hand-drawn printer-shaped model sketch arrived on 10 Nov without index numbers, so the team temporarily carries the placeholder 00/2026.
items.askSr: T76: pošaljite tačne brojeve indeksa i smer članica tima kako bismo zamenili oznaku 00/2026.
items.askEn: T76: send the exact index numbers and programme suffixes of the team members to replace 00/2026.

items.sr: Palata Beograd — Beograđanka (T34): tabelarni pasoš sa 19 izvora i interaktivna aplikacija predati su 11.11. bez brojeva indeksa u dokumentu i mejlu; u registru sa početka semestra stoje 25/26 i 26/26, koji se pojavljuju i u T49 i T02/T42.
items.en: Palata Beograd — Beograđanka (T34): the tabular passport with 19 sources and the interactive application were submitted on 11 Nov without index numbers; the initial register lists 25/26 and 26/26, which also appear in T49 and T02/T42.
items.askSr: T34: potvrdite tačne brojeve indeksa i oznake smera obe članice tima.
items.askEn: T34: confirm the exact index numbers and programme suffixes of both team members.

items.sr: Narodno pozorište (T37): u belešci sa konsultacija 12.10. zavedeno je „33/26 ?, 36/26, 186/26“, dok je 33/26 (OA) na konsultacijama i u mejlu od 09.11. potvrđen u T49. Za T37 je 09.11. predat link AI Studio aplikacije bez brojeva indeksa i na konsultacijama potvrđeno da je pasoš poslat u dva mejla, ali fajl pasoša nije stigao u izvozu.
items.en: National Theatre (T37): the consultation note of 12 Oct lists “33/26 ?, 36/26, 186/26”, whereas 33/26 (Architecture) was confirmed in T49 at the 9 Nov consultations and by email. For T37 the AI Studio link arrived on 9 Nov without index numbers and the team reported at consultations that the passport was sent in two emails, but the passport file did not arrive in the export.
items.askSr: T37: potvrdite sve brojeve indeksa i oznake smera članova tima (posebno zapis „33/26 ?“) i ponovo pošaljite prilog digitalnog pasoša.
items.askEn: T37: confirm all member index numbers and programme suffixes (especially “33/26 ?”) and resend the digital passport attachment.

items.sr: Gardoš (T06): 09.11. predati su link AI Studio aplikacije i 7 fotografija makete utvrđenja u stiroporu i glini (potvrđeno i na konsultacijama 09.11), ali mejl ne navodi broj indeksa podnosioca, dok se brojevi 8/26 i 27/26 iz registra T06 javljaju u još po jednom timu.
items.en: Gardoš (T06): on 9 Nov an AI Studio link and 7 photographs of the styrofoam/clay fortress model arrived (confirmed at the 9 Nov consultations), without the sender’s index number, while 8/26 and 27/26 in T06 overlap with other teams.
items.askSr: T06: potvrdite pun spisak indeksa (uključujući indeks članice koja je poslala maketu i AI Studio) i oznake smera.
items.askEn: T06: confirm the full list of indices (including the member who submitted the model and AI Studio) and programme suffixes.

items.sr: Belgrade Business House (T39): raniji mejl od 01.11. navodi indekse 162/26 i 32/26, registar vodi 34/26 i 162/26 (dok je 32/26 u T12), a na konsultacijama 09.11. najavljeno je da će tim javiti konačan sastav vezano za promenu grupa.
items.en: Belgrade Business House (T39): the earlier email of 1 Nov cites 162/26 and 32/26, the register lists 34/26 and 162/26 (while 32/26 is in T12), and at the 9 Nov consultations the team announced they would confirm the final group membership.
items.askSr: T39: javite konačan sastav tima i potvrdite da li je drugi indeks 32/26 (sa oznakom smera) ili 34/26.
items.askEn: T39: report the final team composition and confirm whether the second index is 32/26 (with programme suffix) or 34/26.

items.sr: Gimnazija „Slobodan Škerović“ u Podgorici (T32): u mejlu od 09.11. predat je link AI Studio aplikacije i navedeno da se šalje i pasoš objekta, ali fajl pasoša nije bio zakačen uz poruku.
items.en: “Slobodan Škerović” Gymnasium in Podgorica (T32): the email of 9 Nov delivered the AI Studio application link and stated that the building passport was attached, but no passport file was attached to the message.
items.askSr: T32: pošaljite dokument digitalnog pasoša (PDF ili DOCX) koji je izostao iz priloga mejla od 09.11.
items.askEn: T32: send the digital passport document (PDF or DOCX) that was missing from the 9 Nov email attachment.

items.sr: Hram Svetog Save (T43): dopunjeni pasoš od 10.11. doneo je linkove za faze gradnje i nove podatke o dimenzijama, 24 bronzanih vrata i kripti, ali na nekoliko mesta još stoji radna oznaka „-izvor“ umesto naziva izvora i linka.
items.en: Church of Saint Sava (T43): the updated passport of 10 Nov added links for construction phases and new data on dimensions, the 24 bronze doors and the crypt, but several claims still carry the placeholder “-izvor” instead of an actual source.
items.askSr: T43: zamenite preostale oznake „-izvor“ tačnim linkovima ili bibliografskim podacima.
items.askEn: T43: replace the remaining “-izvor” placeholders with exact links or bibliographic citations.

items.sr: SIV i Generalštab (T25): petočlani tim obrađuje dva objekta (Palata Srbije i Generalštab); na konsultacijama 09.11. evidentirano je da je pasoš za oba objekta poslat spojeno kao jedan dokument (vraćeno na format tabele podatak → izvor), da stiže nova verzija AI Studio aplikacije i da je jedan prototip makete gotov, dok se druga maketa čeka na kolokvijumu 16.11.
items.en: Palace of Serbia and Generalštab (T25): the five-member team covers two buildings; at the 9 Nov consultations it was noted that the passport for both buildings was sent combined as a single document (returned for claim → source table formatting), a new version of the AI Studio app is forthcoming, and one model prototype is ready while the second model is awaited at the 16 Nov colloquium.
items.askSr: T25: pošaljite tabelarnu verziju pasoša (podatak → izvor) odvojeno po objektu i link nove verzije AI Studio aplikacije.
items.askEn: T25: send the tabular passport version (claim → source) per building and the link to the new AI Studio application.

items.sr: Indeksi 183/26 i 7/26 (tim prisutan na prvom predavanju i na konsultacijama 09.11): čekaju se naziv objekta, digitalni pasoš sa izvorima, link AI Studio aplikacije i skica makete kako bi tim dobio broj tima u registru.
items.en: Indices 183/26 and 7/26 (team present at the first lecture and at the 9 Nov consultations): the building name, sourced digital passport, AI Studio application link and model sketch are awaited so that the team can be assigned a team number in the register.
items.askSr: 183/26 i 7/26: pošaljite naziv objekta, digitalni pasoš, AI Studio link i skicu makete da biste dobili broj tima.
items.askEn: 183/26 and 7/26: send the building name, digital passport, AI Studio link and model sketch to receive your team number.

items.sr: Pred kolokvijum 16.11. digitalni trag skica (ručno crtan materijal) postoji za {skice} od {timova} timova, trag AI aplikacije za {ai}. Ostali timovi možda rade, ali evidencija to ne vidi.
items.en: Ahead of the colloquium on 16 Nov, a digital trace of sketches (hand-drawn material) exists for {skice} of {timova} teams, and of the AI application for {ai}. Other teams may be working, but the record does not see it.
items.askSr: Svi timovi: pošaljite fotografije skica i link AI aplikacije pre 16.11.
items.askEn: All teams: send photographs of your sketches and the AI application link before 16 Nov.
